title: Claude Code expands local AI workflows #claudecode #aiworkflows #localai
description:
Claude Code now runs full workflows with a GitHub pack of 60+ free skills that turn it from a chatbot into a practical local automation system. It can create files, run code, control desktop apps, build presentations, generate Excel models, and analyze competitor ads.

The key shift is from AI assistance to AI execution. Instead of prompting for ideas and manually doing the work, users can give Claude real capabilities that act directly on their computer.

Because everything runs locally, the setup also addresses one of the biggest barriers to AI adoption in business workflows: data privacy. That makes it relevant for creators, operators, analysts, and teams looking for automation without sending sensitive information to external systems.

Phygital is also mentioned as a source for AI users looking for standout models in this space.
